title: RepoAssure AI IDE Repair Workflow CLI Productization v0.1
objective: Expose the existing package-owned AI IDE repair workflow through stable installed hardening repair subcommands while preserving current contracts, redaction, maintainer review, and no-write boundaries.
acceptance: Add stable hardening repair handoff, execute, patch-plan, and evidence-package CLI subcommands that delegate to existing package-owned runners.
Keep existing pnpm repair scripts compatible and preserve runner schemas, errors, redaction, maintainer-review boundaries, and no-write proof.
Cover option parsing and runner delegation with unit tests, installed CLI behavior with integration or smoke tests, and package compatibility with existing tests.
Fail closed for unsupported write or automatic patch application options.
Cascade implementation evidence through canonical product, operations, testing, acceptance, decision, development, and Autopilot records.
Do not expand the MCP tool registry in this acceptance-sized goal.
